_meta.description: Data-driven thresholds for the backward-chaining expert system.
_meta.methodology: Thresholds set at P25 (severe) and P15 (critical) of the full student cohort distribution at each reference week. These percentiles were chosen because at-risk students' medians cluster near P25-P35, so flagging below P25 captures the most disengaged tail.

low_engagement.description: Student VLE click activity in the last 2 weeks is below the 25th percentile of the cohort at that week.
low_engagement.note: Declining thresholds reflect natural engagement tapering across the cohort after initial course enthusiasm.

very_low_engagement.description: Student VLE click activity in the last 2 weeks is below the 15th percentile — critically disengaged.

low_cumulative_clicks.description: Total cumulative clicks to date fall below the 25th percentile.

low_active_days.description: Number of active VLE interaction days this week is critically low.
low_active_days.source: active_days at P25 (consistently ~1 day/week for at-risk students)

low_avg_score.description: Average assessment score so far is below the 25th percentile of scored students.
low_avg_score.source: avg_score_so_far at P25 ≈ 66-70 across reference weeks

very_low_avg_score.description: Average assessment score so far is below the 15th percentile — academically at severe risk.

low_weighted_score.description: Cumulative weighted score so far falls below the 25th percentile.

missed_assessments.description: Student has submitted fewer assessments than the cohort 25th percentile at that week.

has_late_submissions.description: Student has at least 1 late submission. At-risk median = 0, but any lateness is a signal.
has_late_submissions.source: late_submissions_so_far > 0 (observed r=+0.14 with at-risk status at week 5)

negative_wow_change.description: Week-over-week click change is negative (engagement declining).

risk_scoring.description: Risk score = (number of triggered sub-goals / total possible sub-goals) * 100. Risk level thresholds are calibrated to yield ~30% High, ~25% Medium, ~45% Low across the student population, matching the actual ~31% withdrawal + fail rate in OULAD.

rules.description: The rule base for backward chaining. Each top-level goal decomposes into sub-goals resolved against student facts.
